verdict.rationale: Runway documents two first-party MCP offerings: 'Runway MCP' for connecting Runway to agents such as Claude and ChatGPT, and 'Dev MCP' for connecting Cursor, Claude Code, or Codex to a Runway Dev account. Both are only one-line mentions, so depth is unproven. Missing for 10: details on the exposed MCP tools and capabilities, setup and auth documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the MCP servers work.
